overview.description: The WHITEWOLF Publicly Listed Private Equity ETF (LBO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in financials equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that seeks long-term capital appreciation and current income by investing in a narrow basket of US-listed private equity companies across all market capitalization. LBO was launched on Nov 30, 2023 and is issued by WHITEWOLF.

holdings.infoBox: LBO is an equity ETF with a total of 39 individual holdings. The top holdings are Apollo Global Management stock at 10.63%, Ares Capital at 10.58%, Blackstone Secured Lending Fund at 7.81%, Ares Management at 7.59%, and KKR & Co. at 7.52%.
